lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five quasi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, spanning the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of small, discrete high-luminance blobs is distributed primarily within the anterior and medial regions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin. A dark, linear horizontal marking is present on the lower lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral side of the pectoral fin and lower abdominal region.
